project.name: rl
project.description:
In-core Reinforcement-Learning subsystem: human/verifiable reward capture, per-turn trajectory recording, a per-agent contextual bandit (Thompson sampling over Beta posteriors) for the handful of SAFE, non-side-effecting decision dimensions (model route, reasoning depth, prompt variant, tool subset, generation params), and a DPO-style preference export for the out-of-process Python trainer.
Deliberately an EXPOSE-only module: it never wires itself into the agent runtime. It publishes two integration interfaces (RlPolicyPort, RlTurnRecorder) and one Spring AI Advisor bean (RlTrajectoryAdvisor, mirroring chat/LlmMetricsAdvisor) that the orchestrator registers in AnthropicAgentChatClientFactory alongside LlmMetricsAdvisor. Promotion of an offline-optimized prompt to a live agent stays a human action - this module offers export/import only, never auto-writes Agent.systemPrompt.
Depends on: security (TenantContext - schema-per-tenant isolation is automatic, so RL tables carry NO tenant_id and live in db/migration/tenant), chat (reuses LlmMetricsAdvisor's AGENT_ID_PARAM/SESSION_ID_PARAM advisor convention so the orchestrator threads ONE set of params for both advisors), plus spring-web/validation/data-jpa and the Spring AI advisor API. Nothing in core depends back on rl - a one-directional leaf addition, same shape as eventbus/devices/graphmemory.
